entities.summary: Charles Gordon "Chase" Carey is an Irish-born American executive who is a board member of Fox Corporation and Liberty Media. He is the former chief executive officer and executive chairman of the Formula One Group. He has previously worked for News Corp, DirecTV, 21st Century Fox and Sky plc.
